description_en: Modifies the global vulnerability scanning configuration for the current Alibaba Cloud account and returns the complete updated configuration
description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号的漏洞扫描全局配置，并返回修改后的完整配置
kebab_example: aliyun csas update-vul-scan-global-config --max-download-speed 1048576 --wuying-vul-fix-config AntiShutdownSwitch=true SnapshotSwitch=true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVulScanGlobalConfig

parameters.help_en: The maximum download rate for vulnerability patches on a single user terminal device. Unit: Byte/s. A value of 0 indicates no speed limit
parameters.help_zh: 单个用户终端设备下载漏洞补丁的速率上限。单位为Byte/s。取值为0表示不限速
parameters.name: max_download_speed

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to prohibit shutdown during the fix process to prevent system exceptions caused by shutting down during patch installation. Valid values:
true: Prohibit shutdown.
false: Do not prohibit shutdown
fields.help_zh:
修复期间是否禁止关机，用于避免补丁安装过程中因关机导致系统异常。取值：
true：禁止关机。
false：不禁止关机
fields.name: anti_shutdown_switch

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to create a snapshot for the cloud desktop before the fix for rollback in case of fix failure. Valid values:
true: Create a snapshot.
false: Do not create a snapshot
fields.help_zh:
修复前是否为云桌面创建快照，用于修复失败后回滚。取值：
true：创建快照。
false：不创建快照
fields.name: snapshot_switch

parameters.help_en: The vulnerability fix configuration for WUYING Workspace. This configuration applies only to user terminal devices of the Cloud Desktop type
parameters.help_zh: 无影云桌面的漏洞修复配置。仅对无影云桌面类型的用户终端设备生效
parameters.name: wuying_vul_fix_config
